correctness.rationale: Conditional changes of initial-root degree and total leaves yield an exact inhomogeneous covariance recursion including their joint-event correction. Two mean identities are proved by induction; the forcing term is strictly positive from size three onward. Gamma products yield the root-degree scale. After subtracting the candidate 1/(3+2δ) multiple, a positive product and an absolutely summable normalized forcing prove the residual is smaller order for all fixed δ>-1. Six exact-rational distribution enumerations to size 11 and six large-n recurrence experiments are ancillary reproducibility checks.

value.rationale: Connects two canonical observables at distinct growth scales—degree of a specified founder hub and total tree leaves—in the current affine preferential-attachment family. Establishes the sharp positive mixed-covariance sign, full parameter-dependent power law, and a universal normalized coefficient, directly addressing a structural dependence invisible in either marginal law. Its precise crossover depends on attraction offset and gives a benchmark for joint network-statistic inference; no generic CLT or inferential rate is claimed.
